name: Khorgos Gateway dry port
value: 49% bought in 2017 (24.5% each); COSCO paid about $38m for its share
lender_builder: COSCO Shipping and Lianyungang Port; KTZ (Kazakh railways) keeps 51%
china_gets: A minority stake in the main rail transfer hub on the China-Europe overland route, linked to Lianyungang's sea-rail service
host_position: Kazakhstan says the deal brings Khorgos into COSCO's global logistics network and makes it a regional hub
confidence_reason: Stakes and the deal confirmed by Kazakh state news agency and company filings as reported by port.today

name: Central Asia-China gas pipeline, Lines A-C
value: Three parallel lines of about 1,830km each; 55 bcm/yr combined (A and B 15 bcm each, C 25 bcm); opened 2009-2014
lender_builder: CNPC with Turkmen, Uzbek and Kazakh state gas companies
china_gets: About a fifth of China's gas use from Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan, by an overland route that avoids sea lanes
host_position: Transit states earn fees and an export outlet; Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan have cut exports to meet winter demand at home
confidence_reason: Capacities from a peer-reviewed Nature Communications table and S&P Global

name: Central Asia-China gas pipeline, Line D
value: 966km, 30 bcm/yr planned; Tajik section needs 42 tunnels (63.3km); Tajikistan expects more than $3bn of Chinese investment
lender_builder: CNPC (Trans-Asia Gas Pipeline Co) with Tajiktransgaz, Uzbekneftegaz and Kyrgyz partners
china_gets: A shorter route for gas from Turkmenistan's Galkynysh field
host_position: Tajikistan says its section is settled and blames price disputes between other countries; construction has been halted since the 2014 groundbreaking
confidence_reason: Groundbreaking documented; current status reported only through Tajik minister's statements and an unnamed S&P source

name: Kazakhstan-China oil pipeline (Atasu-Alashankou)
value: 965km, 20m tonnes/yr capacity; 11.2m tonnes moved in 2024; also carries 10m t/yr of Russian oil to China
lender_builder: Kazakhstan-China Pipeline LLP: 50% KazTransOil, 50% CNPC's CNODC
china_gets: Half ownership of a direct crude line into Xinjiang, plus a transit route for Russian oil
host_position: Kazakhstan says the pipeline gives its oil a route east; it set Russian transit tariffs until 2034
confidence_reason: Ownership, capacity and volumes from the operator and KazMunayGas

name: China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway
value: $4.7bn estimated cost; about $2.3bn as a 35-year loan from CDB and China Exim (signed December 2025); 304km in Kyrgyzstan with 29 tunnels and 50 bridges
lender_builder: China Development Bank and China Exim; joint company 51% China, 24.5% each Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan; China Railway International builds
china_gets: Majority control of a new rail route from Kashgar to the Fergana Valley and on to Afghanistan, Iran and Europe, bypassing Russia
host_position: Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan call it a strategic route to new markets; the loan is owed by the joint company
confidence_reason: Financing terms published by Kyrgyzstan's Cabinet and state news agency

name: Pamir land handed to China
value: About 1,000-1,158 sq km of the Eastern Pamirs transferred (ratified January 2011)
china_gets: Territory in the Pamirs; China describes the settlement as ending its claim
host_position: Tajikistan says it gave only about 3.5-5.5% of the land China had claimed; claims that the transfer was in exchange for debt relief are not confirmed
confidence_reason: The land transfer is documented (BBC, peer-reviewed study); the debt-for-land link is reported only by secondary analysts

name: Chinese troop presence near the Wakhan corridor (Shaymak)
value: Dozens to hundreds of Chinese troops reported at an outpost since about 2016
china_gets: A position overlooking the Wakhan corridor into Afghanistan, near China's western border
host_position: Both governments deny that a Chinese base exists
confidence_reason: Based on Washington Post interviews and imagery and secondary analysis; officially denied

name: Dushanbe-2 power plant and TBEA gold concession
value: 400 MW plant financed by China Exim loans (phase 2 RMB929.9m); TBEA got the Upper Kumarg and East Duoba gold deposits until it recovers costs
lender_builder: China Exim Bank; TBEA built it
china_gets: Gold mining rights in exchange for building the plant; mining started in 2019
host_position: Tajikistan says the plant ended winter power shortages in Dushanbe
confidence_reason: Loan in AidData; the swap was described in The Diplomat and Interfax

name: Bishkek CHP modernisation
value: $386m China Exim preferential buyer's credit; TBEA did the work; the plant broke down in January 2018
china_gets: The building contract and loan repayment
host_position: A Kyrgyz parliamentary inquiry found no feasibility study and inflated prices; two former prime ministers were jailed in 2019

name: China Exim loans to Kyrgyzstan (Datka-Kemin line, North-South road)

host_position: Kyrgyzstan says the line and road link its north and south

host_position: Uzbekistan says the line joins the Fergana Valley to the rest of the country by rail without crossing Tajikistan

name: PetroKazakhstan and the Shymkent refinery
value: CNPC bought PetroKazakhstan for $4.18bn (2005); the Shymkent refinery is now 50% KazMunayGas, 50% CNPC
